Space Skyboxes Lite
===================

4 stylized space skyboxes for 3D games. Every sky comes as a 4096 x 2048
equirectangular panorama, a 6-face cubemap (1024 px faces) and an HDR
panorama for lighting and reflections.

WHAT'S INSIDE
  Nebulae (1): nebula rose blue
  Galaxies (1): galaxy spiral blue
  Black holes (1): black hole gold
  Ringed giants (1): ringed giant amber
  4 panoramas, 4096 x 2048 JPG (high quality, 4:4:4)
  4 cubemaps, 6 faces of 1024 x 1024 JPG (24 faces)
  4 HDR panoramas, 1024 x 512 Radiance .hdr (lighting/reflections)
  2 seamless 2D parallax layers, 1024 x 1024 PNG: 2 star layers
    (far and near, white, transparent)
  manifest.json listing every file

FORMATS
  Panoramas and cube faces are JPG at quality 94 with full color (no
  chroma subsampling): the best size/quality balance for skies.
  HDR files are Radiance RGBE (.hdr): star cores, suns, black hole disks
  and supernovae go above 1.0, so they bloom and light your scene.
  Parallax layers are PNG with alpha.

FOLDERS
  willosuna_space/<sky>/<sky>_panorama_4096.jpg
  willosuna_space/<sky>/<sky>_cube/px.jpg nx.jpg py.jpg ny.jpg pz.jpg nz.jpg
  willosuna_space/<sky>/<sky>_hdr_1024.hdr
  willosuna_space/parallax/stars/
  willosuna_space/manifest.json

SEAMLESS, CHECKED BY CODE
  Every sky is generated as a function of direction on the sphere, so the
  panorama wraps with no seam and has no pinching at the poles. The cube
  faces are cut from the same sky and their 12 edges are compared pixel by
  pixel. The parallax layers tile in both directions. All of it is
  verified by an automatic check before export.

GODOT 4
  WorldEnvironment > Environment > Background: Sky > Sky Material:
  PanoramaSkyMaterial > Panorama = <sky>_panorama_4096.jpg (or the .hdr).
  Parallax: Sprite2D with Region enabled and Texture > Repeat: Enabled,
  then move region_rect over time.

UNITY
  Panorama: Texture Shape 2D, Wrap Mode Repeat, Max Size 4096, material
  with the Skybox/Panoramic shader (Mapping: Latitude Longitude Layout).
  Cubemap: material with the Skybox/6 Sided shader:
    Front [+Z] = pz   Back [-Z] = nz   Left [+X] = px
    Right [-X] = nx   Up [+Y] = py     Down [-Y] = ny
  The faces follow Unity's axis convention, so the panorama and the
  cubemap show the same sky the same way.

UNREAL, BLENDER, GAMEMAKER, THREE.JS...
  Any engine that accepts an equirectangular panorama or 6 cube faces.
  Blender: World > Environment Texture with the .hdr or the .jpg.

HOW IT WAS MADE
  Every sky is generated by original code written for this pack: periodic
  3D noise on the sphere, star catalogs, spiral galaxies, ray-traced
  planets and rings, a lensed black hole, supernova shells and auroras.
  No photos, no third-party art.

THE FULL PACK
  Space Skyboxes: 53 skies in 11 themes, panorama + cubemap + HDR,
  24 parallax layers, a lossless PNG + 2048 HDR download and a
  Godot 4 demo.
  https://willosuna.itch.io/space-skyboxes
